title: Cancel Action Goal
text: Cancel active action goal in ROS 2 network, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Show ErrorCode output port} enables error code output port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: UUID
ports.summary: Unique ID dedicated to any goal message non-virtual bus

ports.name: Enable
ports.summary: Boolean value to send cancel request for an active action goal true or 1 | false or 0

ports.name: Response
ports.summary: Response message for cancel goal request non-virtual bus

ports.name: ErrorCode
ports.summary: Error conditions while canceling action goal integer

params.name: Show ErrorCode output port
params.values: Enable error code output port off (default) | on
